mapper.select: SELECT id, author_name AS authorName, pet_info AS petInfo, title, attached_report AS attachedReport, content, comments_count AS commentsCount, likes_count AS likesCount, time_ago AS timeAgo, created_at AS createdAt FROM community_posts ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, author_name AS authorName, pet_info AS petInfo, title, attached_report AS attachedReport, content, comments_count AS commentsCount, likes_count AS likesCount, time_ago AS timeAgo, created_at AS createdAt FROM community_posts WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts (author_name, pet_info, title, attached_report, content, comments_count, likes_count, time_ago) VALUES (#{authorName}, #{petInfo}, #{title}, #{attachedReport}, #{content}, #{commentsCount}, #{likesCount}, #{timeAgo})
